svg.title: Decision maps
svg.desc: Action chosen by each algorithm's best genome for an obstacle at a given distance and game speed. Dark: jump. Accent: duck. Pale: nothing.
svg.text: What the best genome of each algorithm does as an obstacle approaches
Across: distance to the obstacle, 0 to 400 px. Down: game speed, 6 at the top to 13 at the bottom.
Dark: jump. Accent: duck. Pale: nothing.
